name: Caspofungin
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 70 mg IV loading dose on day 1, then 50 mg once daily (infuse over about 1 hour)
50 mg once daily, no loading dose
35 mg once daily (70 mg load where appropriate)
70 mg once daily (consider with nevirapine, efavirenz, carbamazepine, dexamethasone, phenytoin)

key_interactions.effect: Higher caspofungin AUC; transient ALT/AST rises (label).

common: Raised ALT, AST and alkaline phosphatase

contraindications: Hypersensitivity to caspofungin or any component

pk.half_life: Beta phase 9 to 11 hours; gamma phase 40 to 50 hours
